description.value: Enhanced Item. Threads of rare cortosis ore are woven through this reinforced gauntlet, a metal that shorts out a lightsaber blade on contact. Once per short rest, when you would be hit by a melee attack from a lightweapon, you can use your reaction to interpose the gauntlet: the attack automatically misses, and the attacking lightweapon's blade flickers out until the start of its wielder's next turn.
